routeFamily.fallbackPolicy: All three render-runtime.js legacy switch fallbacks fail loudly if the D2 renderer is unavailable.

semanticSlot.dataControlToken: identity-only token; excluded from UiEvent schema and native enums

r2aInstrumentation.chapterIdentityPolicy: Fixture chapters use explicit stable business keys such as chapter-32-rain-night; ordinal, selector, DOM position and display-label fallback are prohibited.
r2aInstrumentation.unknownIdentityPolicy: Fail closed; an unknown route/settingsKey emits no data-control-key.

r2bRealInteraction.runtimeWiring: render-runtime.js binds the production DOM controls to the owner actions/helpers while retaining existing route navigation and overlay motion hooks.
guards: invalid detail state, TOC mode and source values return the same state
source sheet and delete dialog are mutually exclusive
duplicate loading starts return the same state or a duplicate result
success/failed async results are accepted only from loading
delete dialog cannot close while delete is loading
ariaAndFocus: chapter collections expose list/listitem and native button semantics
directory/bookmark options expose mutually exclusive aria-pressed
source sheet and delete dialog expose role=dialog, aria-modal and labelled relationships
sheet/dialog initial focus and trigger focus-return markers are deterministic
loading actions expose aria-busy and disabled
failed delete exposes aria-invalid with an error description

resolvedContractDecisions.decision: book-directory is the canonical local LibraryShell route. Reader Full Directory may be a downstream Figma node/visual-state label only; it must not create a second route, UiEvent owner or business flow.

The normal detail page retains the existing quick source chooser sheet. The explicit source-switch route remains the recovery/full-switch flow used by no-toc actions. Figma must represent both intents without merging their owners.
The local canonical target remains immersive-reading. A Figma node labelled Reader Control Home is only a downstream visual destination representation and must not replace the local route contract.

identityDistributionAfterNativeButtonMig.note: 18 chapter actions migrated from role=button articles to native buttons; the semantic denominator remains 3808.

figmaDecisionsRequired.requirements: Repair Phone and Tablet masters through canonical Hero, ActionBar, Summary and Chapter components; downstream instances inherit; no screenshot or detached replacement.
Default, Pressed, Focus, Disabled, Loading and Selected/Current intent must preserve stable chapter identity and at least 44x44 hit targets.

figmaDecisionsRequired.decision: Quick source sheet versus source-switch flow
figmaDecisionsRequired.requirements: Keep the quick chooser as a page-owned overlay exception and the source-switch route as a downstream flow; document both node bindings separately.
Reuse canonical dialog/status components with busy, failed, focus-return and retry evidence.
Phone 390x844 and Tablet 760x960 only; landscape aliases Tablet; no Compact/Fold structure.
